stem: What was the main reason President Monroe made this statement?

options.label: F
options.text: To strengthen political alliances with European allies

options.label: G
options.text: To address European competition for natural resources

options.label: H
options.text: To increase U.S. military readiness for European expansionism

options.label: J
options.text: To prevent European intervention in countries near the United States

visual_elements: The American continents, by the free and independent condition which they have assumed and maintain, are henceforth not to be considered as subjects for future colonization by any European Power. —President James Monroe, message to Congress, 1823
